描述_ZN: Fan Page with Flowers and Insects, Qing dynasty, painted by Yu Shen, on paper with color, 19.3 cm in length and 56 cm in width.　　The fan page is inscribed with the following inscription: "I touched on the interest in the dense foliage, and dotted the grass and insects from the dense leaves. I wrote this as a corrective for Wailao Daweng. Only Ting Yu saves." Inscriptions of "Yu" and "Save" in vermilion, and "Yixing" in vermilion at the head.　　This work is a sketch of a small-scale painting in color, depicting dragonflies, grasshoppers, praying mantis, ladybugs and other insects enjoying themselves among flowers and plants. Yu is a painter who pays attention to life drawing and believes that the most vivid and touching paintings are the ones that touch the scenery, and that only by taking heaven and earth as his teacher can he create a masterpiece. For this reason, he engraved the chapters of "The Heart of Heaven" and "Spring Rain" to express his intention of "touching the heart of life at the right place". This painting is not a work of imperial command, but a gift from the author to a friend, so it was created entirely according to Yu's own wishes, making it the most authentic painting of Yu's artistic style. The artistic language of the whole painting is simple, from composition to brushwork and ink, without embellishment. The picture is colored with rich colors, forming a bright, clean and elegant tone against each other, and overflowing with the freshness of nature.
